title: The Simpler Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.5.4 does not properly restrict who can create orders and checks its…
description: The Simpler Checkout WordPress plugin versions before 1.5.4 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not properly restrict order creation permissions and uses an automatic login link with a key that remains empty until the store owner completes plugin setup. This flaw allows subscriber-level users on stores that have not completed setup to log in as administrators.
